how: I gave ArchiveFile a destination buffer at [file+0x28], then called vtable slot 2 (0x83230) with (0,222717); the routine copied the decoded file out and it saved as 223717 bytes, exactly matching the entry raw length.
why_earlier_attempt_failed: slot 2 returns 0 immediately when [file+0x28] is null, which is why my first call reported success but produced nothing. Supplying the destination buffer made it work.

file_layout.186906: material block: baseTexture, bumpTexture, specTexture, specularColor, specularPower, outlineThickness
